_comment: MIS-138 D1.1 — the classifiers the guards and the telemetry instrument share. Data, not code: any language reads this file. Each block names the ruling it transcribes; change the ruling, change the block, every consumer follows. Before 2026-09-02 three private copies of `series` and three of `apparatus` lived in count-evidence.py, lint-naming.mjs and lint-frontmatter.mjs and drifted (CHANGELOG 2026-09-02, naming-baseline 2 → 0).

series._comment: MIRROR of the STD-001 Series table for prefix, digits and threshold (rules.test.mjs compares thresholds). ADR-005 v1.2.0 register, by top-level directory. `prefix` may list alternatives. `dailyDate`: RPT-YYYY-MM-DD is legal for `subtype: daily` only (ADR-004 rule 3). history/ and agents/ deliberately absent (ADR-035 §2; ADR-005 v1.1.0 reversal). `naming`: false = no filename scheme is enforced (agents/ is folder-named but its frontmatter id is still checked: none legal).

retiredPrefixes._comment: Prefixes that no longer name a series but still appear in prose and must resolve for reference checking (std-012-corpus-does-not-grow ID_RE). D- closed 2026-08-31 (RPT-001 §12). S- (standards, pre-MIS-109) and P- (protocols, pre-MIS-125) added 2026-09-03 — same shape as D-, found during the standards/ refactor: 168 and 287 live citations respectively, invisible to this guard until now.

apparatus._comment: D-014: scaffolding around a series, not a member of it. A document is apparatus if `type: meta`, or its basename is listed here, or its path matches a pattern. lint-naming, lint-frontmatter (IS_TEMPLATE) and count-evidence each held a partial copy of this list.

types._comment: STD-004 §5 HDR-003 closed type vocabulary; HDR-017 type ↔ series, strict except `lax`.

status._comment: MIRROR of STD-004 'Status lifecycles' — the table there is the declaration; rules.test.mjs fails when this block and that table differ. Two lifecycles: a mission's, and everyone else's. One terminal state (`withdrawn`); an heir is the field `superseded_by`, never a second state (relation model — ISO stage codes, RFC 2026 `Obsoletes:`, NIST CSRC). `closed` and `superseded` retired 2026-09-09. `_terminal` is the set every guard reads for 'closed record, a photograph' (CIT-053).

subtypes._comment: STD-004 §5 HDR-018; `report` closed since ADR-005 v1.2.0.

governed._comment: STD-004 §10: the top-level directories whose tracked .md files std-004-the-header governs. Everything else (web/, machine/scripts/, root, .github/) is out of its scope.
